guide.title: Nazeebo's Overview
guide.text:
Nazeebo is a Mage able to deal a good amount of
burst damage and a decent amount of
sustained damage from the distance, provided with
some crowd control and a high Health pool.
While his damage looks decent at any stage of the game, Nazeebo becomes a real
threat only in the late game.

guide.title: Nazeebo's Strengths and Weaknesses
guide.text:
Strengths
Decent sustain damage
Good burst damage
Zoning potential
Unique crowd control via Zombie Wall
High maximum Health
Access to Ice Block
Weaknesses
Weak early game
Zero mobility

Nazeebo's Zombie Wall Build combines a bit more safety with high damage output
against enemy Heroes who cannot play around Zombie Wall
by using their own Abilities or with the help of allied Heroes.
The increased casting range provided by Thing of the Deep at Level 1
helps Nazeebo hit enemies with his Abilities—especially Zombie Wall—and
gives him extra safety at any stage of the game, unless dove.
While his early game
damage is not that great, the additional Spell Power provided empowers both his
Heroic Abilities, something that will compensate this little weakness during
big team fights in the later stages of the game.
Attention! Once you reach Level 20, if you are too far from having
175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, do not pick
Vile Infection because it would do nothing.
Upgrade your Heroic Ability instead.

guide.title: Nazeebo's Synergies and Counters
guide.text:
Nazeebo synergizes with
In order to make Nazeebo work, we recommend
picking a Marksman (such as Sylvanas) to guarantee
your team a good damage output when your Abilities are on cooldown and a
Tank who can provide crowd control
(such as Mal'Ganis) that Nazeebo will be able to follow up
with Zombie Wall. There are also some Healers
who can get value from Zombie Wall after it spawns, usually by adding crowd control
(for example Auriel using Detainment Strike).
Nazeebo is countered by
Nazeebo is countered by Heroes who can punish his weak
early game (such as Sylvanas that can
enable her team to push by using Haunting Arrows
to disable Structures) and he is rendered almost useless by Heroes who can
easily get out from Zombie Wall and eventually dodge
his other Abilities (for example E.T.C. can use
Face Melt to Knockback the Zombies
surrounding himself or a nearby allied Hero).

guide.title: Nazeebo's Maps
guide.text:
Nazeebo's stronger maps
Nazeebo's average maps
Nazeebo's weaker maps
Nazeebo requires to rotate between two lanes in order to
gather stacks for Voodoo Ritual as quickly as possible
and eventually unlock Vile Infection at Level 20.
As a consequence, he is good on Maps where it is fast and safe to rotate
between lanes (such as rotating mid-top on
Tomb of the Spider Queen)
and he should not be picked on Maps where it is impossible to rotate because there are
only 2 lanes (like Braxis Holdout),
where it is slow and/or dangerous to rotate between lanes (for example
Cursed Hollow), or on
mid-game Maps where there is a low chance to reach Level 20
(such as Sky Temple).

guide.title: Nazeebo's Tips and Tricks
guide.text:
If you last-hit a Minion with Corpse Spiders, the Spiders can potentially run towards a nearby Hero.
Zombie Wall can be used to tank Structures.
Considering that Plague of Toads can be difficult to hit, use it on enemy Heroes coming towards you.
When the Objective is not active, focus on Voodoo Ritual to unlock Vile Infection in the late game.
See our Abilities page for further information »

guide.title: Nazeebo's Role in the Current Meta
guide.text:
Nazeebo is the Mage with the second highest maximum
Health (only second to Azmodan), able to deal solid amount
of burst damage and some good but avoidable
poke damage during team fights while also having high
waveclear for the laning phase.
A well-placed Zombie Wall can be a lethal
crowd control effect against many Heroes who do not
have any Ability to counter it, especially if their allied Heroes have the same
weakness.

abilities.title: Nazeebo's Tips and Tricks
abilities.text:
If you last-hit a Minion with Corpse Spiders, the Spiders can potentially run towards a nearby Hero.
Zombie Wall can be used to tank Structures.
Considering that Plague of Toads can be difficult to hit, use it on enemy Heroes coming towards you.
When the Objective is not active, focus on Voodoo Ritual to unlock Vile Infection in the late game.

abilities.title: Corpse Spiders
abilities.text:
Corpse Spiders
(Q)
Nazeebo
Mana: 40
Cooldown: 8 seconds
Hurl a jar of spiders that deals 50 (+4% per level) damage. If it hits at least one enemy, create 3 Corpse Spiders that attack for 38 (+4% per level) damage. Spiders last for 4 seconds.
Corpse Spiders is a high-damage Ability that consists
of a pot with Spiders inside it. Even if the pot deals damage too,
the majority of the damage dealt by this Ability comes from the Spiders themselves.
It is good to know that Spiders are immune to damage and will relentlessly attack the
target enemy Hero for 4 seconds and eventually deny
them from channeling an Objective for the duration.

abilities.title: Zombie Wall
abilities.text:
Zombie Wall
(W)
Nazeebo
Mana: 70
Cooldown: 14 seconds
After 1 second, create a ring of Zombies surrounding the target area that deal 28 (+4% per level) damage and last for 3 seconds.
Zombie Wall is a powerful Ability that provides
a unique form of crowd control by creating a circle
of Zombies that block the path and attack nearby enemies at the same time,
but it can either be dispersed with Knockback effects
(such as Face Melt by E.T.C.), jumped over (for example
with Dwarf Toss), or destroyed with damage
(partially, by attacking a single Zombie, or completely, by damaging all of them
with something like Blizzard). Although it is primarily used
to immobilize enemy Heroes within the ring, allowing you and your allies
to easily follow up with damage,
it can also be used to completely block off
narrow paths (for example the Gates between Towers), to tank the attacks of
neutral Mercenaries (including Bosses),
and to tank the shots from enemy Structures.

abilities.title: Plague of Toads
abilities.text:
Plague of Toads
(E)
Nazeebo
Mana: 30
Charges: 2
Recharge Time: 8 seconds
Create a wave of 3 Toads that explode on contact, dealing 126 (+4% per level) damage over 6 seconds. This effect stacks.
Stores up to 2 charges.
Plague of Toads is a unique Ability that generates 3 Toads jumping in the
chosen direction, each with a different angle. Toads are slow,
therefore this Ability is mostly used to kill Minions and clear Mercenaries,
to zone enemy Heroes that prefer not to take damage,
or to safely poke enemy Heroes who are trying to
channel an Objective.
Sometimes you can also use it as a follow-up on allied
crowd control, however, if you are too far from them,
you will not hit the enemy Heroes in time regardless.
Since all the Toads start from Nazeebo, a melee Hero (such as Thrall)
will immediately take burst damage from all of them.

abilities.title: Gargantuan
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Gargantuan
(R)
Nazeebo
Heroic
Mana: 90
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.
Gargantuan is a Summon that deals a significant amount of
Spell Damage with Basic Attacks and can effectively zone
low-Health or generally vulnerable Heroes out of a team fight by itself. You can
use this Heroic Ability in various ways, from damaging enemy Heroes to tanking enemy Structures.
Gargantuan Stomp is a very low cooldown Ability that can be used by Nazeebo
to order Gargantuan to deal damage to enemy Heroes and Slow them.

abilities.title: Ravenous Spirit
abilities.text:
In this section we discuss how this Heroic Ability works and give some tips on how to use it.
If you are looking for a detailed explanation on when and why you should pick it,
check out the dedicated section in the Talent Build page.
Ravenous Spirit
(R)
Nazeebo
Heroic
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.
When you have Ravenous Spirit, always look for
a safe position to cast it from.
You do not necessarily have to hit multiple Heroes because getting a kill
with a Heroic Ability is already a good trade.
Zombie Wall can be used to block off a path before casting,
preventing some Heroes from interrupting you.

abilities.title: Voodoo Ritual
abilities.text:
Voodoo Ritual
(D)
Nazeebo
Passive
Nazeebo's Basic Attacks and Abilities poison Non-Heroic enemies, causing them to take 66 (+4% per level) additional damage over 6 seconds.
Quest: If a Minion dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, Nazeebo permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana.
Voodoo Ritual is a Trait that causes Nazeebo's
Basic Attacks and Abilities to deal damage over 6 seconds to non-Heroes hit.
When clearing Minions, to maximize your damage output, you should try to
quickly hit each of them at least once.

abilities.title: Baseline Quest
abilities.text:
Nazeebo has a Baseline Quest which requires you to kill Minions affected
by Voodoo Ritual. Whenever you do that, Nazeebo
permanently gains 6 Health and 1 Mana, making him harder to kill in the
late game.
When playing as Nazeebo, you should try your best to make
sure that all enemy Minions nearby are affected by
Voodoo Ritual as they die.
When playing with a Nazeebo in team, you should give Nazeebo enough
time to debuff every Minion with Voodoo Ritual
before killing them, otherwise he will not get stacks for his Baseline Quest.

Hexed Crawlers is a strong Talent that
restores about 12-20% maximum Health and 12-20% maximum Mana when using Corpse Spiders
on enemy Heroes, boosting your survivability during team fights.
The amount of Health and Mana restored depends on other Talents.
To get the most out of this Talent, combine it with
Widowmakers at Level 1,
Spirit of Arachyr at Level 7
and either Spider Colony
or alternatively Soul Harvest at Level 16.
✔
Big Voodoo
(Level 4)
Nazeebo
Increases the Health and Mana bonuses from Voodoo Ritual by 100%.
Big Voodoo is a good Talent that increases maximum Health and maximum Mana
values based on the Quest progress of Vile Infection. To give you an idea,
175 stacks at Level 20 translate to about 30% maximum Health and 20% maximum Mana
rather than 15% maximum Health and 10% maximum Mana.
Being directly dependent on Voodoo Ritual stacks
makes Big Voodoo way less effective in the
early game compared to
Blood Ritual and Hexed Crawlers.
?
Blood Ritual
(Level 4)
Nazeebo
If an enemy dies while poisoned by Voodoo Ritual, restore 2% of Nazeebo's maximum Health and Mana.
Passive: Takedowns grant 3 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.
Blood Ritual is a situational Talent that
gives 2% maximum Health and Mana when killing enemies
affected by Voodoo Ritual.
This effect works on Monsters (for example the
Skeletal Guardians on Infernal Shrines) as well.
In addition to that, taking down enemy Heroes will slightly help
you stack Voodoo Ritual.
Thanks to this Talent, you can regenerate up to 14% maximum Health
and 14% maximum Mana per wave of Minions while laning. This effect
is great while laning because it helps you stay on the battlefield
for longer, especially when there is no Healer
to keep you healthy and when you would otherwise get low on Mana.

talent_pages.title: Level 7 Talents for Nazeebo
talent_pages.text:
?
Spirit of Arachyr
(Level 7)
Nazeebo
The number of Corpse Spiders spawned is increased from 3 to 4. If Corpse Spiders' jar hits only one enemy, it creates an additional spider.
Spirit of Arachyr is a strong Talent that increases
the number of Spiders generated by Corpse Spiders.
You get one extra Spider just for having this Talent and then another
extra Spider if the Ability impacts on a single target.
✔
Dead Rush
(Level 7)
Nazeebo
Zombie Wall deals 100% more damage. When it expires up to 5 remaining Zombies uproot and attack nearby enemies, losing Health over 3 seconds.
Dead Rush is a good Talent that doubles the damage done by
Zombie Wall and makes it spawn a few Zombies when it ends.
The damage increase provided by this Talent is not that reliable because
most Heroes are small enough to stand exactly in the middle of Zombie Wall
to avoid all its damage and some Heroes can kill or Knockback
some of the Zombies away.
?
Toads of Hugeness
(Level 7)
Nazeebo
Increase the damage and explosion radius of Plague of Toads by 25% after each hop, up to a maximum of 100%.
Toads of Hugeness is a decent Talent that increases the damage
done via Plague of Toads based on the distance traveled.
The effect provided by this Talent allows
Nazeebo to zone enemy Heroes or to take down Structures
while pushing with his team, but it gets zero value
when enemy Heroes get close to you during team fights.

talent_pages.title: Level 10 Talents for Nazeebo
talent_pages.text:
In this section we discuss when and why to pick a given Heroic Ability.
If you want to read how they work in detail and/or you are looking for some tips on how to use them,
check them out on the Abilities and Strategy page.
✔
Gargantuan
(Level 10)
Nazeebo
Mana: 90
Cooldown: 70 seconds
Summon a Gargantuan to guard an area, losing Health over 29 seconds. Deals 100 (+4% per level) damage when summoned, attacks for 140 (+4% per level) damage, and can be ordered to stomp nearby enemies. The Gargantuan's Stomp deals 240 (+4% per level) damage and Slows by 30% for 2 seconds.
Gargantuan is a good Heroic Ability that can be used to deal more damage,
to zone vulnerable enemy Heroes out of a team fight,
or to tank enemy Structures while sieging.
Pick it while playing against a dive composition
that can consistently interrupt Ravenous Spirit
and/or when you want to deal more damage to enemy Structures when left unchecked.
?
Ravenous Spirit
(Level 10)
Nazeebo
Mana: 100
Cooldown: 90 seconds
Channel a Ravenous Spirit that deals 230 (+4% per level) damage per second. Cannot move while channeling. Lasts for 8 seconds.
Ravenous Spirit is a strong Heroic Ability that will deal more damage than
Gargantuan over its duration, but there are a number of
drawbacks attached to using Ravenous Spirit: you are immobile while channeling,
it can be interrupted, and some enemy Heroes can run away from it.
Pick it when the enemy team does not have too many interrupts
that you find too hard to play around (by waiting them to be used or by outranging them),
otherwise they will quickly neutralize it and you will basically end up playing the game
without a Heroic Ability.

talent_pages.title: Level 13 Talents for Nazeebo
talent_pages.text:
?
Guardian Toads
(Level 13)
Nazeebo
Hitting an enemy Hero with Plague of Toads grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, stacking up to 6 seconds.
Guardian Toads is a decent Talent that gives you a fair amount
of Armor when hitting enemy Heroes with Plague of Toads.
Hitting multiple Heroes before the buff provided by this Talent falls off will extend its duration,
up to a maximum of 6 seconds.
We find this Talent slightly better against team compositions that feature multiple melee Heroes
as they will tend to group together and easily get hit by Plague of Toads,
however, we think it can rarely compete with Ice Block.
?
Superstition
(Level 13)
Nazeebo
Gain 40 Spell Armor. Heroic Basic Attacks against Nazeebo remove this bonus for 3 seconds and spawn a Corpse Spider to attack the Hero.
Superstition is a situational Talent that gives you a high but conditional amount of
Spell Armor that can be useful while playing against
a poke composition. Basic Attacks against you
will disable the Armor buff for a few seconds and spawn a Spider
like Corpse Spiders that will focus the Hero who attacked you.
✔
Ice Block
(Level 13)
Nazeebo
Cooldown: 60 seconds
Activate to place yourself in Stasis and gain Invulnerability for 3 seconds.
Ice Block is a strong Talent that can drastically increase your survivability
by either allowing you to dodge enemy Abilities or giving your team time to assist
you.

talent_pages.title: Level 16 Talents for Nazeebo
talent_pages.text:
?
Spider Colony
(Level 16)
Nazeebo
Corpse Spider Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Nazeebo's Basic Abilities by 0.125 seconds.
Spider Colony is a strong Talent that lowers the cooldown
of all Nazeebo's Basic Abilities when hitting enemy Heroes with Corpse Spiders.
The cooldown reduction provided is particularly good in synergy
with other Corpse Spiders-related Talents
because you will be able to cast them about twice as often as usual.
✔
Ring of Poison
(Level 16)
Nazeebo
Zombie Wall lasts 1 second longer, and the center is filled with poison that deals a total of 319 (+4% per level) damage over 4 seconds. This damage starts small and increases over the duration.
Ring of Poison is another decent Talent that adds damage
and duration to Zombie Wall, however,
it also cannot compete with Soul Harvest.
?
Soul Harvest
(Level 16)
Nazeebo
Cooldown: 15 seconds
Activate to increase Nazeebo's Health and Spell Power by 7% for each nearby enemy, up to a maximum of 35%. Lasts 15 seconds.
Soul Harvest is a good offensive and defensive
Talent that temporarily gives Spell Power and maximum Health based on
the number of enemies hit (including Structures).
A common trick is to safely
walk near Minions just before a team fight starts to boost your stats for free.
If you want to get the buff during a team fight, do not be greedy and just hit
the enemy front line as they engage on you.

talent_pages.title: Level 20 Talents for Nazeebo
talent_pages.text:
?
Humongoid
(Level 20)
Nazeebo
Gargantuan Stomp's area is increased by 25% and its Slow amount is increased to 50%.
Passive: Reduce Gargantuan's cooldown by 40 seconds and its Mana cost by 50%.
Humongoid is a decent Talent that allows you to spam
Gargantuan once every 30 seconds,
cover a bigger area with his activable Stomp,
and apply a better Slow on enemy Heroes.
Considering that it
lasts 20 seconds, you will have Gargantuan on the battlefield 2/3 of the time,
unless the enemy team deals with it. The high uptime
is particularly useful on Maps with narrow areas
and where the Objective takes a while to be secured.
It is important to know that, like for other similar cases, you
will not immediately get the cooldown reduction if you pick this Talent
while Gargantuan is on cooldown already.
?
Annihilating Spirit
(Level 20)
Nazeebo
When Ravenous Spirit damages an enemy Hero, reduce their healing received by 50% for 1 second and increase Ravenous Spirit's damage by 5% for the rest of its duration.
Passive: Increases the range of Ravenous Spirit by 50%.
Annihilating Spirit is a strong Talent that
allows you to cast Ravenous Spirit from a safer distance
and for more damage while also constantly applying an healing reduction effect
to all enemy Heroes hit.
The damage and healing reduction effect provided by this Talent
are powerful tools to have at your disposal during team fights,
especially if you are playing against a team composition
with a lot of healing at their disposal.
✔
Vile Infection
(Level 20)
Nazeebo
Quest: Reach 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual.
Reward: After reaching 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual, it can also be applied to Heroes and its damage is increased from 66 (+4% per level) to 165 (+4% per level) over 6 seconds.
Vile Infection is a strong Quest-based Talent that,
after getting 175 stacks of Voodoo Ritual—it
does not matter if before or after picking this Talent—turns Nazeebo into a
late game powerhouse by buffing
his Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities significantly.
When playing Nazeebo, you should poison as many
enemy Minions with your Abilities or Basic Attacks
before killing them, else you would have less maximum Health and less maximum Mana
and you would lose the opportunity to pick Vile Infection.
When you are not sure if you will be able to complete
Vile Infection before winning or losing the game,
do not lock your Level 20 Talent unless you really need it for an important
team fight or if your team is going for Core to end the game, in which case
you just pick another Talent—usually upgrading your Heroic Ability—because
an incomplete Vile Infection would be literally useless.
?
Bad Medicine
(Level 20)
Nazeebo
Cooldown: 30 seconds
Consume 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual to become Unstoppable, gain 20% increased Movement Speed, and 50 Armor for 2 seconds.
Bad Medicine is a situational Talent that, once every
30 seconds, can be activated by paying 5 stacks of Voodoo Ritual
to become Unstoppable as well as gain Movement Speed
and a fair amount of Armor for a few seconds.
You may use this Talent as a tool against aggressive enemy Heroes
who have access to crowd control to punish you,
however, a well-played Ice Block should usually be enough.
You can also use this Talent to run away from enemy Heroes who
have no mobility tools to reach you
after you run away thanks to the burst of Movement Speed it provides.
